backend/main.mo: Motoko backend managing users, plans, invoices, and anonymous event/usage tracking with admin‑restricted analytics.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Prewritten summaries of multiple frontend files for reference or documentation.
frontend/DEPLOYMENT_SLUG.md: Documentation defining the required deployment slug and validation rules.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind base styles and theme variables for light and dark modes.
frontend/index.html: Base HTML entry point loading the React app.
frontend/PRODUCTION_PUBLISH_V4.md: Full production deployment checklist covering build, deploy, validation, and rollback steps.
frontend/PRODUCTION_SMOKE_CHECK.md: Runbook for verifying production functionality, routes, authentication, and Stripe checkout.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Main app component configuring all routes and theme provider.
frontend/src/components/auth/LoginButton: Internet Identity login/logout button with loading state and query cache reset.
frontend/src/components/invoice/InvoiceD: Form step that collects invoice details, validates mandatory fields, checks historical VAT rates, and prepares data for the next step.
frontend/src/components/invoice/InvoiceM: Displays which mandatory invoice fields are complete and shows alerts for missing fields or full completion.
frontend/src/components/invoice/InvoiceP: Generates the invoice HTML preview, performs risk checks, and handles saving and downloading invoices with quota and plan checks.
frontend/src/components/invoice/InvoiceR: Modal panel showing invoice risk analysis results, highlighting critical issues, warnings, and disclaimers.
frontend/src/components/layout/AppLayout: Defines the global app layout with header navigation, footer, authentication-aware links, and initial analytics logging.
frontend/src/components/payments/StripeA: Admin-only component for configuring Stripe keys and allowed countries using backend mutations.
frontend/src/components/payments/StripeC: Button that triggers Stripe checkout session creation and redirects users to the payment page.
frontend/src/components/usage/LimitReach: Shows a modal when free usage is exhausted, logs an event, and links users to the upgrade page.
frontend/src/components/usage/UpgradeMod: Displays upgrade plan options with pricing, logs impressions, and navigates to the upgrade page.
frontend/src/components/usage/UsageLimit: Shows remaining invoice quota for free accounts based on monthly usage.
frontend/src/components/vat/CountrySelec: Lets users choose the customer’s country for VAT calculation and proceeds to the next step.
frontend/src/components/vat/ExplainVatPa: Displays detailed and simplified VAT explanations with a Pro‑gated PDF export option.
Paywall dialog prompting users to upgrade for VAT explanations and logging upgrade impressions.
Renders a visual stepper indicating progress through VAT calculation steps.
frontend/src/components/vat/ReverseCharg: Validates reverse charge eligibility, logs checks, and shows pass/fail indicators with explanations.
frontend/src/components/vat/TransactionD: Collects transaction details, logs calculation events, handles B2B VAT ID checks, and advances the flow.
frontend/src/components/vat/VatResultsSt: Renders VAT calculation results, legal notes, and upgrade/OSS actions with event logging and plan checks.
frontend/src/config/appMeta.ts: Defines app metadata and validates deployment slug format with a regex check.
frontend/src/hooks/useAccountPlan.ts: Fetches the user's active plan and invoice usage from the backend using react-query.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and manages the authenticated or anonymous backend actor, updating dependent queries when it changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useAnonymousUsage.ts: Tracks anonymous daily usage via fingerprinting with limits and incrementing through backend calls.
frontend/src/hooks/useCreateCheckoutSess: Creates Stripe checkout sessions via the backend and validates returned session URLs.
frontend/src/hooks/useDailyFingerprint.t: Generates a daily fingerprint and detects user country for anonymous tracking.
frontend/src/hooks/useEventLogger.ts: Wraps event logging with fingerprint and country data, sending events through the backend logger.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides Internet Identity auth state, login, logout, and identity loading via AuthClient.
Provides invoice listing, PDF/ZIP downloads, and export mutations via backend actor.
frontend/src/hooks/useInvoiceQuota.ts: Manages invoice saving with plan-based monthly limits and invalidates related queries.
frontend/src/hooks/usePlanAccess.ts: Exposes helpers indicating whether the user has free, starter, or pro plan access.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Fetches caller user profile and Stripe configuration state from the backend.
frontend/src/index.css: Defines Tailwind layers and custom OKLCH theme variables, plus utilities and components like watermark styles and print adjustments.
frontend/src/lib/analytics/coreEvents.ts: Provides fixed core analytics event names and a type for valid event strings.
frontend/src/lib/analytics/countryDetect: Fetches country and IP from ipapi.co for lightweight geolocation with error handling.
frontend/src/lib/analytics/eventLogger.t: Builds and sends event records with metadata such as device, page, and timestamp to the backend.
frontend/src/lib/analytics/fingerprint.t: Generates a daily SHA‑256 fingerprint using IP, user agent, and date, with caching utilities.
frontend/src/lib/invoice/buildInvoiceHtm: Constructs the full invoice HTML string using input data, translations, formatting, and legal VAT text.
frontend/src/lib/invoice/getAutoLegalVat: Returns scenario‑specific default legal VAT wording for invoices.
frontend/src/lib/invoice/riskCheck.ts: Runs invoice risk checks for mandatory fields, reverse charge validity, and scenario‑based warnings.
frontend/src/lib/invoice/validateInvoice: Validates presence of required invoice fields and returns which mandatory checks failed.
frontend/src/lib/production/productionMa: Logs a versioned production‑build marker and exposes the marker string for testing.
frontend/src/lib/translation/deToEn.ts: Provides deterministic offline German‑to‑English translation plus a heuristic for detecting German text.
frontend/src/lib/vat/calculateVat.ts: Implements German VAT calculation logic including exemptions, reverse charge, digital services, intra‑EU supply, and historical rates.
frontend/src/lib/vat/explainVat.ts: Generates detailed human-readable explanations for each VAT scenario based on calculation results.
Provides simplified, child-friendly explanations of VAT scenarios.
frontend/src/lib/vat/germanyVatRateHisto: Stores historical German VAT rates and utilities to retrieve rates for given dates and detect historical differences.
frontend/src/lib/vat/index.ts: Re-exports VAT calculation and explanation modules for easier imports.
frontend/src/lib/vat/ossIndicator.ts: Checks whether a transaction requires OSS registration based on service type and cross‑border EU B2C rules.
frontend/src/lib/vat/promptFlowGermany.t: Defines prompt templates and system instructions for a Germany VAT calculation flow.
frontend/src/lib/vat/validateReverseChar: Validates whether reverse charge can be applied by checking VAT ID format and country match.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Initializes the React application with query client and Internet Identity provider.
frontend/src/pages/CalculatorFlowPage.ts: Implements the multi-step VAT calculator UI flow, managing form data, VAT calculation, navigation, and invoice preview logic.
frontend/src/pages/InvoicesPage.tsx: Page for listing invoices with selection, PDF downloads, ZIP exports, and upgrade-gated features.
frontend/src/pages/LandingPage.tsx: Marketing landing page showcasing VAT calculator features and navigation to the calculator.
frontend/src/pages/PaymentFailurePage.ts: Displays payment failure message with options to retry or return home.
frontend/src/pages/PaymentSuccessPage.ts: Shows payment success, logs event, refreshes plan data, and links to calculator or invoices.
frontend/src/pages/UpgradePage.tsx: Subscription upgrade UI with plan selection, Stripe checkout, authentication checks, and error handling.
frontend/src/utils/downloadFile.ts: Utility to trigger client-side file downloads for text and binary content.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utilities for reading URL parameters, persisting them in session storage, and managing hash-based params.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind configuration with extended color tokens, container settings, keyframes, and plugins.
project_state.json: Metadata describing project state, versioning, and feature request status.
